title: 1491: New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus
reason: As someone rooted in an Indigenous background, this book hits different. 1491 demolishes the Eurocentric default narrative of pre-colonial Americas and replaces it with something far richer and more complex — exactly the kind of novel, destabilising lens I look for. Social science doctorate means the methodological arguments hold my attention. Left perspective, decolonial in spirit, long-form depth. Solid pick for a nomad who thinks mainstream history is mostly a story told by the wrong people.
